review_scope: Direct visual inspection of every rendered original metadata 06/07 PNG; no production changes.
checks: original chart composition with explicitly labelled NN scope additions
primary mean-fold versus secondary pooled scope

figures.notes: Primary equal-fold AP/AUC: original five-model, two-panel composition; spline blue, seeds orange, mean charcoal. Values, prevalence reference and labels readable.
Secondary pooled AP/AUC: same original five-model, two-panel composition and semantic palette; pooled label and malignant-image reference explicit.
Additional fixed NN stability diagnostic: seed markers distinguish the three orange runs; blue spline and charcoal ensemble visible; legend and long title fit.
Additional fixed NN stopping-duration diagnostic: all seed markers and charcoal median visible, with unobstructed upper-right legend and readable axes.
Additional fixed NN histories: five fold rows and stopping/refit columns aligned; orange fit and charcoal stopping losses distinguish phases; top legends, titles and lower axes readable.
Additional 36-recipe NN search: all 15 panels and 180 AP annotations readable; one shared blue scale; selected recipes outlined gold; global colour bar does not overlap panels.
Additional selected-setting frequency: three gold panels with integer counts and complete setting labels; title and panel headings separated.
Additional selection-margin diagnostic: gold bars and six-decimal margin labels readable; y-axis shows tiny differences without truncation.
Additional tuned NN stopping-duration diagnostic: gold seed symbols and charcoal median, unobstructed lower-left legend, full outer-fold labels.
Additional fold-gain diagnostic: four model panels, common vertical scale, gold square markers and grey zero references; titles and axes separated.
Primary equal-fold ROC-AUC: four fixed/tuned model pairs; original blue/gold bars, separate figure, original width/edge conventions and readable four-decimal labels.
Primary equal-fold AP: four fixed/tuned model pairs; original blue/gold palette, separate metric figure and readable four-decimal annotations.
Secondary pooled ROC-AUC: same four-model blue/gold composition; secondary title explicit; labels, values and legend unobstructed.
Secondary pooled AP: same four-model blue/gold composition; secondary title explicit; labels, values and legend unobstructed.
Pooled ROC/PR: original left/right curve composition expanded to a labelled fourth NN row; blue dashed circles versus gold solid squares, original 0–30% PR focus, all legends and eight axes readable.
Additional paired patient-bootstrap diagnostic: gold intervals with darker gold squares, full comparison labels, grey zero line and explicit conditional-on-predictions title. No clipping.

limitations: This review covers rendered figures; numerical correctness and notebook section depth are covered by separate verified artifacts and tests.
Additional search diagnostics extend the archived experiment scope; identical pixels to historical outputs are not expected.
